ucs.title: [LLM] Volt Typhoon NTDS.dit extraction via ntdsutil IFM on Domain Controllers
ucs.description: Hunts the actor's signature credential-access move: dumping the Active Directory database via `ntdsutil` 'Install From Media' on a compromised DC, then collecting/staging `ntds.dit` + SYSTEM hive. CISA AA24-038A and Microsoft both call this Volt Typhoon's preferred LOTL credential harvest because it leaves no malware and uses a legitimate Windows role binary.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name="ntdsutil.exe" (Processes.process="*ac i ntds*" OR Processes.process="*activate instance ntds*" OR Processes.process="*create full*" OR Processes.process="*ifm*") by Processes.dest Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process _time span=1h | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | join type=outer dest [| tstats summariesonly=t count as ndts_write values(Filesystem.file_path) as staged_path from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_name="ntds.dit" OR Filesystem.file_name="SYSTEM" OR Filesystem.file_name="SECURITY") Filesystem.action=created by Filesystem.dest | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`] | where isnotnull(staged_path) | eval risk_score=85, threat_actor="Volt Typhoon (G1017)" | table firstTime lastTime dest user parent cmdline staged_path threat_actor
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let WindowMinutes = 30m;
let NtdsutilExec = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName =~ "ntdsutil.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("ac i ntds","activate instance ntds","create full"," ifm ")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project NtdsTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              NtdsCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
let StagedArtifacts = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed")
    | where FileName in~ ("ntds.dit","SYSTEM","SECURITY","ntds.jfm")
         or FolderPath has_any (@"\IFM\", @"\Active Directory\", @"\Temp\")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("ntdsutil.exe","cmd.exe","powershell.exe")
    | project StageTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, StagedFile = FolderPath,
              StagingProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName;
NtdsutilExec
| join kind=inner StagedArtifacts on DeviceId
| where StageTime between (NtdsTime .. NtdsTime + WindowMinutes)
| project NtdsTime, StageTime,
          DelayMin = datetime_diff('minute', StageTime, NtdsTime),
          DeviceName, AccountName, NtdsCmd, ParentCmd, StagedFile,
          ThreatActor = "Volt Typhoon (G1017)"
| order by NtdsTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let WindowMinutes = 30m;
let NtdsutilExec = SecurityEvent

let StagedArtifacts = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4663
    | where ObjectName has_any ("ntds.dit","\\IFM\\","\\Active Directory\\","SYSTEM","SECURITY")
    | where ProcessName endswith_cs "ntdsutil.exe" or ProcessName endswith_cs "cmd.exe" or ProcessName endswith_cs "powershell.exe"
    | project StageTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, StagedFile = ObjectName,
              StagingProcess = ProcessName;
NtdsutilExec
| join kind=inner StagedArtifacts on Computer
| where StageTime between (NtdsTime .. NtdsTime + WindowMinutes)
| project NtdsTime, StageTime,
          DelayMin = datetime_diff('minute', StageTime, NtdsTime),
          Computer, SubjectUserName, NtdsCmd, ParentName, StagedFile,
          ThreatActor = "Volt Typhoon (G1017)"
| order by NtdsTime desc

title: Volt Typhoon NTDS.dit Extraction via ntdsutil IFM
id: 7f3a91d8-volt-ntdsutil-ifm
status: experimental
description: Detects ntdsutil.exe invoked with Install-From-Media flags to dump the Active Directory database, a Volt Typhoon credential-access hallmark on compromised DCs.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa24-038a
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1017/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/10
tags:
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1003.003
  - attack.g1017
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '\ntdsutil.exe'
  selection_args:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'ac i ntds'
      - 'activate instance ntds'
      - 'create full'
      - ' ifm '
  filter_machine:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_img and selection_args and not filter_machine
fields:
  - Image
  - CommandLine
  - ParentImage
  - User
  - ComputerName
falsepositives:
  - Authorized DC backup operations using IFM
  - AD recovery / restore procedures
level: high

ucs.title: [LLM] Volt Typhoon LOTL hands-on-keyboard reconnaissance burst from single cmd.exe lineage
ucs.description: Hunts the actor's signature post-exploitation discovery pattern: a single cmd.exe (often spawned from an edge-device webshell or wmiprvse) rapidly enumerating host/domain/network state with native Windows tools — the exact command sequence documented by CISA, NSA and Microsoft for Volt Typhoon/Vanguard Panda intrusions into US critical infrastructure.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as commands dc(Processes.process_name) as distinct_lolbins values(Processes.process_name) as lolbins from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name="cmd.exe" Processes.process_name IN ("ipconfig.exe","netstat.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","systeminfo.exe","tasklist.exe","whoami.exe","quser.exe","query.exe","hostname.exe","ping.exe","wmic.exe","nltest.exe","dnscmd.exe","reg.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.parent_process_guid Processes.user _time span=10m | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where distinct_lolbins >= 6 | search commands="*/all*" OR commands="*domain trusts*" OR commands="*dclist*" OR commands="*group \"domain admins\"*" OR commands="*user /domain*" OR commands="*qwinsta*" | eval risk_score=80, threat_actor="Volt Typhoon / Vanguard Panda (G1017)" | table firstTime lastTime dest user distinct_lolbins lolbins commands threat_actor
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let BurstWindow = 10m;
let MinDistinctLolbins = 6;
let VtLolbins = dynamic(["ipconfig.exe","netstat.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","systeminfo.exe","tasklist.exe","whoami.exe","quser.exe","query.exe","hostname.exe","ping.exe","wmic.exe","nltest.exe","dnscmd.exe","reg.exe","arp.exe","route.exe"]);
let VtSignatureArgs = dynamic([" /all"," domain trusts"," dclist:"," group \"domain admins\""," user /domain"," group /domain"," qwinsta"," /domain"," os get "," process list"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "cmd.exe"
| where FileName in~ (VtLolbins)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| summarize StartTime = min(Timestamp), EndTime = max(Timestamp),
            DistinctLolbins = dcount(FileName),
            Lolbins = make_set(FileName, 25),
            Commands = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 50),
            ParentChain = make_set(strcat(InitiatingProcessParentFileName, " -> ", InitiatingProcessCommandLine), 10)
            by DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessId,
               bin(Timestamp, BurstWindow)
| where DistinctLolbins >= MinDistinctLolbins
| extend HasVtSignature = array_length(set_intersect(
    Commands,
    todynamic(strcat('["', strcat_array(VtSignatureArgs, '","'), '"]'))
  )) > 0
   or Commands has_any ("domain trusts","dclist:","domain admins","user /domain","qwinsta","/all")
| where HasVtSignature
| extend ThreatActor = "Volt Typhoon / Vanguard Panda (G1017)",
         BurstDurationSec = datetime_diff('second', EndTime, StartTime)
| project StartTime, EndTime, BurstDurationSec, DeviceName, AccountName,
          DistinctLolbins, Lolbins, Commands, ParentChain, ThreatActor
| order by StartTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let BurstWindow = 10m;
let MinDistinctLolbins = 6;
let VtLolbins = dynamic(["ipconfig.exe","netstat.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","systeminfo.exe","tasklist.exe","whoami.exe","quser.exe","query.exe","hostname.exe","ping.exe","wmic.exe","nltest.exe","dnscmd.exe","reg.exe","arp.exe","route.exe"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName endswith_cs "\\cmd.exe"
| extend ChildName = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where ChildName in (VtLolbins)
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where SubjectUserName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| summarize StartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EndTime = max(TimeGenerated),
            DistinctLolbins = dcount(ChildName),
            Lolbins = make_set(ChildName, 25),
            Commands = make_set(CommandLine, 50),
            ParentCmds = make_set(ParentProcessName, 10)
            by Computer, SubjectUserName, ProcessId,
               bin(TimeGenerated, BurstWindow)
| where DistinctLolbins >= MinDistinctLolbins
| where Commands has_any ("/all","domain trusts","dclist:","domain admins","user /domain","group /domain","qwinsta","os get","process list")
| extend ThreatActor = "Volt Typhoon / Vanguard Panda (G1017)",
         BurstDurationSec = datetime_diff('second', EndTime, StartTime)
| project StartTime, EndTime, BurstDurationSec, Computer, SubjectUserName,
          DistinctLolbins, Lolbins, Commands, ParentCmds, ThreatActor
| order by StartTime desc

ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/^cmd\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(ipconfig|netstat|net1?|systeminfo|tasklist|whoami|quser|query|hostname|ping|wmic|nltest|dnscmd|reg|arp|route)\.exe$/i
| UserName!=/\$$/

ucs.rationale: Volt Typhoon's hallmark — explicitly documented in CISA AA24-038A and the Microsoft 'Volt Typhoon targets US critical infrastructure' report — is malware-free LOTL discovery. They consistently run a tight, recognizable cluster of native binaries (whoami, net group 'domain admins' /domain, nltest /dclist:, ipconfig /all, netstat -ano, wmic process list, quser) from one cmd.exe within minutes of gai
